# V2 Repository Plan and PR Approval Sequence (proposed)

Manifest KOS-V2-PR-PIPELINE, status **PROPOSED**. The order is a default topological order from the dependency list, not permission to merge every repository regardless of readiness. Independent work can go in parallel; a downstream PR pins the exact dependency versions it was tested against. The manifest is consumed by `scripts/pipeline/manifest.py` and `ship-prs.sh`. Standards: [ACCEPTANCE_STANDARD.md](ACCEPTANCE_STANDARD.md).

Merge method: **merge** (decision PD-010 is pending). Releases use annotated SemVer tags created only after the approved merge; a tag is evidence, not milestone closure.
